content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for GDEC Principal Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.gdec.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GDEC Principal recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the GDEC Principal recruitment is 24 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Principal post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. degree and a First Class at either Bachelor's or Master's level. Additionally, they need to have guided at least two Ph.D.s and have 8 research publications.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are required for the Principal position?
faq.answer: A minimum of 15 years of experience in teaching, research, or industry is required. Out of this, at least 3 years must be at a post equivalent to that of a Professor.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for the GDEC Principal post?
faq.answer: The application process for the GDEC Principal post is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Principal in the GIDC Degree Engineering College.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of GIDC Degree Engineering College, which is www.gdec.in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Principal post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Principal post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of GDEC?
faq.answer: The official website of GIDC Degree Engineering College (GDEC) is www.gdec.in.

faq.question: Q10. In which state and city is GDEC located?
faq.answer: GIDC Degree Engineering College (GDEC) is located in Navsari, Gujarat, with the pincode 396406.
